message: module `{module}`: port `{port}` has no direction; it is treated as `inout`
description: Every port is normally declared with a direction (`input`, `output` or `inout`). This one has none, so it is treated as `inout`, which is what an analog port almost always is. Whether the standard allows leaving it out is unsettled in this project, so this is a warning rather than an error.
actions: Declare the direction explicitly, for example `inout p;`.
